assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Lack of official precise regulatory redline and municipal utility capacity data.
assumptions.impact: Provisional boundaries and scenario calculation models are applied; final metrics require recalculation upon official data release.

assumptions.statement: Policy uncertainties regarding autonomous driving and open-source algorithm testing in public space.
assumptions.impact: Tiered admission sandboxes (L1-L3) and human-in-the-loop fallback mechanisms are established.

assumptions.statement: Varying public acceptance and consensus regarding AI technology integration in historical heritage space.
assumptions.impact: Public participation, bilingual wayfinding, and non-digital alternative service channels are provided.

assumptions.statement: Long-term operation and maintenance funding gaps for public AI infrastructure.
assumptions.impact: Multi-agent investment models, open-source governance committee, and commercial lounge revenues are leveraged.

assumptions.statement: Building status classification (retain / renovate / demolish / new) cannot be determined without official building survey data including construction year, structural type, legal status, and current use condition.
assumptions.impact: All building footprints in geometry/buildings.geojson are marked status=unknown. Building density, demolition ratio, and retention ratio are concept-only estimates pending official survey data.

assumptions.statement: All submitted boundaries and derived metrics are ready for one-click recalculation when official site boundary and key-area geometry are released.
assumptions.impact: Geometry layers and metrics are regenerable from the same pipeline; provisional values in this package will be replaced without changing design intent.

assumptions.statement: Wind corridor cooling effect is estimated as a 0.8°C ~ 1.5°C range under peak summer load based on synthetic tabletop CFD reasoning and published ventilation-corridor methodology.
assumptions.impact: The range is a design-stage estimate pending on-site micro-meteorological stations and CFD validation; it must not be cited as a measured or approved performance figure.

assumptions.statement: The Civic Value Protocol revenue-sharing mechanism is positioned as a voluntary CSR charter under the Zhongguancun pilot sandbox framework, not a statutory obligation.
assumptions.impact: The 15% fund ratio and governance rules are concept suggestions for professional teams and authorities to deepen; no investment or legal commitment is implied.
